Name: Harem Valley-OhoDavi's Style
Author: CokeCharger
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod replaces the character portraits from the "Harem Valley" mod with OhoDavi's unique art style. It is designed to be a seamless compatibility patch, keeping the original mod's content while giving the portraits a fresh, stylized look that matches OhoDavi's signature aesthetic. If there is any copyright infringement, please contact me to have the content removed. A huge thank you to Feldspar110, the original creator of [i]Harem Valley[/i], and kanasen, the author of [i]Valley Girls OhoDavi Style[/i]. I am only the one who made simple edits to their images using Photoshop to combine the two works. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Ensure you have the latest version of the base "Harem Valley" mod installed. 
2. Download this mod file. 
3. Replace your original "Harem Valley" mod file with this version. 
4. Make sure this mod loads **after** the base "Harem Valley" mod in your mod load order (adjust priority via SMAPI or Mod Organizer if needed).

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Full portrait replacement for "Harem Valley" in OhoDavi's art style
 - Designed to be fully compatible with the original "Harem Valley" mod 
- No changes to gameplay or dialogue, only visual updates
